description.value:
Requirement Your Feral Bond is at least Alpha stage.

Duration constant

Wherever Shared Strain lets your Feral Bond carry a mutation, it may instead carry a Major mutation in that Slot, at the same shared-Strain cost to you. Whatever grew in you over the years of the bond, it grew in your Bond too.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Strain/Bloom-Table/mutation-Slot economy has no SpecialResource or other Foundry-schema representation anywhere in the corpus (confirmed via grep -rli '"strain"' site/data/cards/classes/, no hits, and grep -rl '"key": "SpecialResource"' site/data/cards/, one unrelated hit in fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json). Feral Bond growth stages (Whelp / Bonded / Alpha / Apex-Touched, classes.waywarden.json:95 terms) have no tracked data field anywhere in the corpus, so a stage requirement like "at least Alpha stage" has no roll option or actor property to predicate against.
